3368388252.detail_text: Tagi. Small Woven Pillow Computer Bag Inspired by the simple joy of everyday comforts, this Tagi. Small Woven Pillow Computer Bag combines soft textures with thoughtful details, embodying a harmonious blend of functionality and charm. Whether you're on your way to work or organizing your workspace at home, its delicate craftsmanship ensures your essentials are always wrapped in a sense of calm and coziness. Every stitch of the Tagi. Small Woven Pillow Computer Bag speaks of care and precision, blending creativity with practicality. The woven pattern exudes understated elegance, while the gentle contours and padded design offer a sense of safety for your electronic essentials. Perfectly sized for daily use, this bag redefines the modern workspace with a touch of warmth. Features Unique Woven Design: A textured blend of elegance and durability, perfect for any style. Padded Interior: Provides a secure and cushioned compartment for your laptop or documents. Lightweight Convenience: Weighing approximately 410g, it offers comfort without compromise. Versatile Shoulder Strap: A woven strap adorned with detachable pendants, combining functionality and flair. Durable Hardware: Zinc alloy accents add a polished, long-lasting finish. Specifications Dimensions: 28.5cm x 38.5cm x 2.5cm Strap Length: 52cm Weight: Approx. 410g Material: Citrus Biscuit: 65% Polyester, 33% Rayon, 2% Spandex Blueberry Biscuit: 72% Polyester, 25% Artificial Cotton, 3% Spandex Hardware: Zinc alloy Care Instructions Hand wash only; avoid machine washing. Use a soft cloth to clean stains gently. Store in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight. Avoid prolonged contact with oily substances, solvents, or alcohol-based products (e.g., perfumes). Notice Slight color differences may occur due to lighting and photography. These variations are normal and do not affect product quality. Dark-colored items may transfer onto lighter fabrics in humid environments; avoid prolonged contact. Handle with care to prevent scratches or tears on the material. Measurements may vary slightly (2-3cm) due to manual measurement methods. Experience the perfect balance of comfort and practicality with the Tagi. Small Woven Pillow Computer Bag. Let it bring effortless charm and thoughtful design into your daily routine.

Tagi. Small Woven Pillow Computer Bag

Inspired by the simple joy of everyday comforts, this Tagi. Small Woven Pillow Computer Bag combines soft textures with thoughtful details, embodying a harmonious blend of functionality and charm. Whether you're on your way to work or organizing your workspace at home, its delicate craftsmanship ensures your essentials are always wrapped in a sense of calm and coziness.



Every stitch of the Tagi. Small Woven Pillow Computer Bag speaks of care and precision, blending creativity with practicality. The woven pattern exudes understated elegance, while the gentle contours and padded design offer a sense of safety for your electronic essentials. Perfectly sized for daily use, this bag redefines the modern workspace with a touch of warmth.



Features

Unique Woven Design: A textured blend of elegance and durability, perfect for any style.

Padded Interior: Provides a secure and cushioned compartment for your laptop or documents.

Lightweight Convenience: Weighing approximately 410g, it offers comfort without compromise.

Versatile Shoulder Strap: A woven strap adorned with detachable pendants, combining functionality and flair.

Durable Hardware: Zinc alloy accents add a polished, long-lasting finish.

Specifications

Dimensions: 28.5cm x 38.5cm x 2.5cm

Strap Length: 52cm

Weight: Approx. 410g

Material:

Citrus Biscuit: 65% Polyester, 33% Rayon, 2% Spandex

Blueberry Biscuit: 72% Polyester, 25% Artificial Cotton, 3% Spandex

Hardware: Zinc alloy

Care Instructions

Hand wash only; avoid machine washing.

Use a soft cloth to clean stains gently.

Store in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight.

Avoid prolonged contact with oily substances, solvents, or alcohol-based products (e.g., perfumes).

Notice

Slight color differences may occur due to lighting and photography. These variations are normal and do not affect product quality.

Dark-colored items may transfer onto lighter fabrics in humid environments; avoid prolonged contact.

Handle with care to prevent scratches or tears on the material.

Measurements may vary slightly (2-3cm) due to manual measurement methods.

Experience the perfect balance of comfort and practicality with the Tagi. Small Woven Pillow Computer Bag. Let it bring effortless charm and thoughtful design into your daily routine.
